notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK checks for ordinary and directed subscription re-evaluation. The scenarios use only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM modules, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. The checks cover ordinary and directed receive-order delivery at the callback boundary and timestamped delivery at the time-constrained grant boundary, including the standard Delay Subscription Evaluation switch and current-subscription filtering.
